dozentwelve-papermorph-papermorph.description: Make or edit animated, narrated, interactive web books from reference PDFs, animated picture books (paper-puppet films) from a story, a joke or a fairy tale, narrated documentaries about a book or an idea, built from public-domain pictures, upright shorts for a phone feed that make one point in under three minutes, scroll stories whose picture changes as the reader scrolls, and maps you explore, where a stretch of history plays year by year and the reader clicks the people and places on it. Use for book planning, storyboards, chapter animation and exercises, narration, and cover and contents…
